answer: Three things hang above the gate, and all three must agree before it opens. Proof of charcoal kiln via burn tally is the agreement: a kiln the burner seals only after he stacks 40 cords he actually cut, and the burn runs 3 days without smoke. The willow hangs left, the nadir hangs right, and the basalt hangs in the middle, heavier than the other two. A cheat must forge all three in a single night, and the middle one still weighs 37 stones too light.
